description: A freelance photographer must decide whether to accept a barter proposal for a portrait session, weighing the proposed exchange against another cash opportunity and relying on an independent inspection of the item offered in trade.

shared_context.S1: Elena has one Saturday morning available for an informal portrait booking in June.
shared_context.S2: Marcus has asked whether Elena would trade a portrait session for a vintage audio component.
shared_context.S3: Elena is also considering other ways to use that Saturday booking slot.
shared_context.S4: Elena's usual practice for a barter is to have a trusted technician check unfamiliar equipment and to write down the agreed session terms before confirming the exchange.

PF1.text: Marcus's exact proposal is one 90-minute family portrait session on Saturday, June 14, 2026, from 10:00 to 11:30 AM, exchanged for an authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 receiver with its original walnut case and matching original speakers, with no additional cash.

PF2.text: Tess was directly offered $240 cash by another client for a 60-minute headshot session on Saturday, June 21, 2026, and has not yet told Elena about that offer.

PF3.text: Ravi inspected Marcus's audio equipment and confirmed that the receiver is an authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 with its original walnut case, and that the matching original speakers are included and working.

acceptance_conditions: Elena must accept Marcus's barter proposal.
The session must be a 90-minute family portrait session on Saturday, June 14, 2026, from 10:00 to 11:30.
The exchange must be the authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 receiver with its original walnut case and matching original speakers, with no additional cash.
The $240 cash alternative must be recorded for comparison.
The receiver's authenticity must be confirmed.
The matching original speakers must be included.
Written barter terms for Marcus must be logged.
The receiver inspection must be recorded and cited as justification.

content_checks.C1: decisions['accepted_offer'] in ['A2', 'Marcus', "Marcus's barter proposal", "Marcus's barter offer", "Marcus's trade proposal", "Marcus's trade offer", 'Marcus barter proposal', 'Marcus barter offer', 'Marcus trade proposal', 'Marcus trade offer', "Marcus's barter proposal: 90-minute family portrait session exchanged for vintage Marantz audio equipment", "Marcus's barter offer of a 90-minute family portrait session on June 14, 2026, 10:00-11:30 AM, exchanged for the vintage Marantz 2230 receiver with original walnut case and matching original speakers, no additional cash", "Marcus's barter offer: 90-minute family portrait session traded for the 1978 Marantz 2230 receiver with original walnut case and matching original speakers", 'yes']
content_checks.C2: decisions['session_kind'] in ['family portrait', 'family portrait session', '90-minute family portrait', '90-minute family portrait session', 'informal family portrait'] and decisions['session_date'] in ['2026-06-14', 'June 14, 2026', 'Saturday, June 14, 2026'] and decisions['session_window'] in ['10:00-11:30', '10:00-11:30 AM', '10:00 to 11:30', '10:00 to 11:30 AM', '10:00–11:30', '10:00–11:30 AM', '10:00 AM to 11:30 AM']
content_checks.C3: decisions['exchange_item'] in ['1978 Marantz 2230 receiver', 'authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 receiver', 'Authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 receiver', '1978 Marantz 2230 receiver with original walnut case and matching original speakers', 'authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 receiver with original walnut case and matching original speakers', 'Authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 receiver with original walnut case and matching original speakers', '1978 Marantz 2230 receiver with original walnut case and matching original speakers, all in working condition', 'authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 receiver with original walnut case and matching original speakers, all in working condition', 'Authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 receiver with original walnut case and matching original speakers, all in working condition'] and decisions['cash_added'] == 0
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['barter', 'barter_terms', 'booking', 'session', 'session_booking', 'portrait_session', 'written_terms', 'write_session_terms', 'session_scheduling', 'terms_documentation'] and c['target'] in ['A2', 'Marcus'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Marcus's exact proposal changes the accepted party to Marcus, fixes the session as a 90-minute family portrait on June 14 from 10:00 to 11:30, fixes the receiver and speakers as the exchange item, and fixes additional cash at zero.
Tess's information changes the comparison record from no concrete benchmark to an exact $240 cash alternative for a competing portrait booking.

Ravi's inspection changes the equipment terms from an unverified receiver to an authentic 1978 Marantz 2230 with matching original speakers included and working, and supplies the inspection record that Elena must log and cite.
